chunks: And the Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn al-Rizq al-Ghamushani, from Mu'awiyah ibn 'Ammar, who said:

Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام instructed me to press his abdomen, then perform wudu (ablution) for him with ushnan, then wash his head with lote leaves and his beard, then pour some of it over his body, then rub his body with it, then pour over him three times, then wash him with pure water, then pour over him water with camphor and with pure water, and place in it seven lote leaves.

key_terms.أَغْمِزَ: to press, specifically the abdomen of the deceased
key_terms.السِّدْرِ: lote leaves used in ritual washing
key_terms.الْأُشْنَانِ: a cleansing substance used in washing
key_terms.الْكَافُورِ: camphor mixed with water for the washing
key_terms.ثَلَاثًا: three times, indicating repetition in the washing process

ai.seo_question: What is the method of washing the deceased according to a hadith from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام in al-Istibsar?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the procedure instructed by Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام for washing the deceased. It details the sequence of cleansing substances and washing steps, indicating jurisprudential guidance for ghusl of the dead in Shia fiqh.
